segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: So, I’ll hand over now to Julie Brooks.

segments.speaker: JULIE
segments.en: Thank you.

segments.speaker: JULIE
segments.en: Welcome to the Sports Centre.

segments.speaker: JULIE
segments.en: It’s good to see that there are

segments.speaker: BROOKS
segments.en: so many people wanting to find out about our sports facilities.

segments.speaker: BROOKS
segments.en: First of all, membership.

segments.speaker: BROOKS
segments.en: All students at the college are entitled to become members of the Sports Centre, for an annual fee of £9.50.

segments.speaker: BROOKS
segments.en: To register with us and get / your membership card, you need to come to reception, between 2 and 6 pm, Monday to Thursday.

segments.speaker: BROOKS
segments.en: I’m afraid we can’t register new members on Friday, so it’s Monday to Thursday, 2 to 6, at reception.

segments.speaker: BROOKS
segments.en: Now, there are three things that you must remember to bring with you when you come to register; they are: your Union card, a recent passport-sized photograph of yourself, and the fee.

segments.speaker: BROOKS
segments.en: It doesn’t matter whether you bring cash or a cheque.

segments.speaker: BROOKS
segments.en: We can’t issue your card unless you bring all three; so, don’t

segments.speaker: FORGET
segments.en: your Union card, passport photo and fee.

segments.speaker: FORGET
segments.en: Then once you have got your sports card, you will need to bring it with you whenever you come to book or use any Sports Centre facilities. / Booking over the phone is not allowed, so you have to come here in person, with your card, when you want to book.

segments.speaker: FORGET
segments.en: Our opening hours seem to get longer every year.

segments.speaker: FORGET
segments.en: We are now open from 9am to 10pm on weekdays and from 10am to 6pm on Saturdays.

segments.speaker: FORGET
segments.en: For those of you who are up and about early in the morning, we are introducing a 50 per cent ‘morning discount’ this year.

segments.speaker: FORGET
segments.en: This is because the facilities tended to be under-used in the mornings last year.

segments.speaker: FORGET
segments.en: It means that all the sessions will be half-price between 9am and 12 noon on weekdays. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- So, what exactly are the facilities?

segments.speaker: FORGET
segments.en: What sports can you play here?

segments.speaker: FORGET
segments.en: Well, this room we are in at the moment is called the Main Hall, and it’s used mainly for team sports such as football, volleyball and basketball, but also for badminton and aerobics.

segments.speaker: FORGET
segments.en: On the other side of the reception area there is / the dance studio; this provides a smaller, more intimate space, which we use for ballet, modern dance and martial arts - not at the same time, of course.

segments.speaker: FORGET
segments.en: Then in a separate building, which you may have noticed on your way here . . . it’s on the other side of the car park . . . there are the squash / courts (six of them), and at the far end of the building a fitness room.

segments.speaker: FORGET
segments.en: This is our newest facility, only completed in the Spring, but it is already proving to be one of the most popular.

segments.speaker: FORGET
segments.en: As well as all these facilities available here on the campus, we also have an arrangement with the local tennis club, which is only two miles away, entitling our students to use their courts on weekday mornings in the Summer.

segments.speaker: FORGET
segments.en: So, I think that there should be something here for everybody, and I hope to see all of you at the Centre, making use of the facilities.

segments.speaker: FORGET
segments.en: If, in the course of the year, you have any suggestions as to how the service we provide might be improved or its appeal widened, I’ll be interested to hear from you.
